primary_gt.decision_rule: rainfall/runoff rows define the threshold; gridded, receptor, and remote rows remain context

event.event_name: July 2021 Henan Zhengzhou extreme rainfall and flood

criteria.name: output_ledger_and_final_label
criteria.description: Returns valid JSON with all five required row ids, formulas, computed values, threshold decisions, failed substitutions, and the final label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a parsable ledger that omits one row or has minor field-name drift while preserving the five-row structure.

criteria.name: burst_runoff_threshold
criteria.description: Computes 201.9 mm, 201900 m3/km2, 171615 m3/km2, normalized runoff index 1.716, and the greater-than-1 threshold result.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct formula with one arithmetic or rounding error that does not reverse the threshold result.

criteria.name: event_window_loading
criteria.description: Computes ratios 3.056, 0.327, and 0.963 and concludes that both the peak burst and multi-day load are needed.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for two correct ratios or a correct conclusion with one missing ratio.

criteria.name: gridded_precipitation_check
criteria.description: Reports means 460.551, 245.924, and 217.454 mm; mean 307.976 mm; three products above 200 mm; range 243.098 mm; ratio 0.746; and the no-substitution conclusion.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points when most numeric values are correct but one aggregation or the substitution explanation is missing.

criteria.name: transport_receptor_check
criteria.description: Computes road share 0.644, bridge share 0.278, tunnel count 2, critical service count 48, population 5263000, and train-suspension lower bound about 30.4 per million.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct counts with one missing derived share or the per-million rate omitted.

criteria.name: remote_change_check
criteria.description: Computes radar ratio 3.124 and reports annual embedding values 0.044 and 0.341 plus true-color difference 13.740 as context metrics.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for two of the three metric groups correct.

criteria.name: reasoning_discipline
criteria.description: Keeps the rainfall/runoff rows as the physical threshold test and treats gridded means, receptors, and overhead change as context checks.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for rejecting at least three weak substitutions without adding extra uncomputed claims.

provenance.notes: Numeric anchors are read from local CSX-063 records; Sentinel-1 p90 is computed from the local raster and true-color mean absolute RGB difference is computed from the local pre/event image pair.
